effect_description_eng:
You may digivolve this card from your hand onto one of your red Tamers as if that card is a level 3 red Digimon.
＜Raid＞ (When this Digimon attacks, you may switch the target of attack to 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP.)
[When Attacking] This Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with the [Hybrid] trait in the hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 1.
